scope: Targeted methodological comparison, not an exhaustive novelty or health-coefficient review.
interpretation_rules: Not established means not demonstrated by inspected text, not proven absent.
Selected full-text sections is not a reproduction audit or claim that every appendix was read.
Indexed primary body sections are distinguished from a directly inspected complete article.
Overlap and transfer limits are reviewer assessments; source findings are not AirGuard results.
Forecast inputs, retrospective reanalysis estimation and general calibration theory are distinct tasks.
Primary versions and access limitations remain explicit; paper references require human editing.
No locked test outcomes, protocol or QC rules were changed for this review.

search_record.approach: Follow inherited primary identifiers; inspect publisher/arXiv/PMLR texts and targeted primary-domain method queries.
not_completed: Systematic databases/search strings and screening log

entries.title: Technical note: Accurate, reliable, and high-resolution air quality predictions by improving the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service using a novel statistical post-processing method
entries.sections_inspected: Main sections 2, 3.1, 3.2, 5; supplement S1 Table S1, S3-S5.
entries.task: Daily PM10/PM2.5; maximum 8-hour O3 and 1-hour NO2; EMOS then INLA-SPDE.
entries.validation_splits: 668 training/82 stratified held-out stations; next-day repetition using previous three days.
entries.inputs_availability: CAMS available 08 UTC. Main 2.2 says ECMWF operational weather; supplement S1 lists ERA5 precipitation, wind and boundary-layer height. Receipt-time audit unresolved.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Predictive distributions, PIT, intervals and exceedance diagnostics; cohort advice not established.
entries.overlap_limits: Direct overlap with CAMS station correction and spatial uncertainty. Weather provenance discrepancy prevents treating this as proof of issue-time validity.
entries.matrix_note: Spatial and next-day validation; operational-weather versus ERA5 discrepancy.

entries.title: Model output statistics (MOS) applied to Copernicus Atmospheric Monitoring Service (CAMS) O3 forecasts: trade-offs between continuous and categorical skill scores
entries.task: O3 MOS; persistence, moving averages, quantile mapping, Kalman, analogs and boosting; 1-4-day leads.
entries.geography_data: Iberian domain and southwestern France; 455 stations; 2018-2019.
entries.validation_splits: Expanding training starts January 2018; only accumulated past observations; matched complete forecast-observation pairs.
entries.inputs_availability: ECMWF HRES forecast weather primary; ERA5 sensitivity separate. Previous-day O3 reporting availability explicitly questioned and ablated.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Continuous versus hits/misses/false alarms; boosting can suppress peaks; tail weighting changes trade-offs.
entries.overlap_limits: Established station CAMS correction. Continuous improvement does not establish extreme-event warning improvement; no cohort health-benefit result.
entries.matrix_note: Expanding past-data MOS; prior-observation availability ablation and warning trade-offs.

entries.title: Calibrating the CAMS European multi-model air quality forecasts for regional air pollution monitoring
entries.version_inspected: 31 January 2022 arXiv v1; journal-version differences not audited.
entries.task: Dynamic gamma-EMOS calibration of nine CAMS members; PM10, PM2.5, O3, NO2 and CO.
entries.inputs_availability: CAMS 08 UTC; dynamic persistence uses 09 UTC observations and previous-day values; WRF forecast weather. Ingestion receipts not audited.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Gamma predictive distribution, CRPS and PIT-based reliability; no cohort advice established.
entries.overlap_limits: Direct overlap with observation/weather-conditioned correction; static calibration does not uniformly beat persistence. No India CPCB-AQI experiment.
entries.matrix_note: 2019/2020 separation plus rolling calibration; probabilistic station correction.

entries.title: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service - Regional Air Quality Production System v1.0
entries.task: European regional operational system; CAMS-MOS random forest uses ensemble concentrations and forecast meteorology.
entries.geography_data: Thousands of European observation sites; PM10, PM2.5, NO2 and O3; 96-hour forecasts.
entries.validation_splits: MOS trains daily on previous three days. System forecasts evaluated against available stations; analyses reserve approximately one-third outside assimilation.
entries.inputs_availability: Forecast, analysis and reanalysis products differentiated. Daily MOS operational in ADS; AirGuard receipt provenance not established.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Ensemble dispersion; threshold-detection diagnostics; no India cohort guarantee.
entries.overlap_limits: Operational precedent for station correction. System description is not an isolated MOS ablation study; reanalysis diagnostic figures are not forecast comparisons.
entries.matrix_note: Operational CAMS-MOS precedent; distinguishes forecast and reanalysis diagnostics.

entries.matrix_note: Indian five-day operational evaluation; peak underprediction and categorical diagnostics.

entries.title: Conformalized Quantile Regression
entries.task: Quantile regression plus held-out conformal interval calibration.
entries.geography_data: Synthetic and 11 generic regression benchmarks; not an air-quality study.
entries.validation_splits: Disjoint proper training/calibration; experiments 40/40/20 train/calibration/test with repeated random splits.
entries.inputs_availability: Preprocessing fitted on proper training; operational issue-time availability outside scope.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Finite-sample rank gives marginal coverage under exchangeability; adaptive interval width.
entries.overlap_limits: Established interval method. Does not automatically guarantee dependent daily, city, vulnerability-cohort or Severe-conditional coverage.
entries.matrix_note: Marginal exchangeability guarantee; separate calibration and test are essential.

entries.authors: Angelopoulos, Bates, Fisch, Lei and Schuster
entries.title: Conformal Risk Control
entries.version_inspected: ICLR 2024 metadata; arXiv v4, 13 June 2025, for inspected theory.
entries.task: Post-process fixed models to control expected bounded monotone loss.
entries.geography_data: Segmentation, multilabel vision, hierarchical classification and question-answering examples; no India air-quality data.
entries.validation_splits: Separate observed calibration losses and unseen test loss; exchangeability required.
entries.inputs_availability: Predict then evaluate unseen point; operational exposure timestamps outside scope.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Expected-risk bound with finite-sample correction; not a high-probability conditional risk bound.
entries.overlap_limits: Under-warning loss can be related only after assumptions/monotonicity are justified. Daily dependence and cohort health risk remain unvalidated.
entries.matrix_note: Expected monotone-loss control; dependent cohort warning guarantee does not follow.

entries.title: Online conformal prediction with decaying step sizes
entries.task: Predict-then-observe interval updates with decaying step sizes.
entries.geography_data: Australian Elec2 demand and ImageNet sequences; no air-quality experiment.
entries.validation_splits: Time-ordered online prediction; Elec2 even/odd sequence/holdout; ImageNet sequence/holdout.
entries.inputs_availability: Base prediction uses past data; score updates after outcome arrival.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Bounded-score arbitrary-sequence long-run coverage; IID quantile convergence under stated conditions.
entries.overlap_limits: Long-run historical coverage is distinct from next-day/cohort-conditional coverage. Static split-conformal calibration does not implement this update method.
entries.matrix_note: Sequential dependence-relevant calibration; long-run coverage is a distinct guarantee.

entries.title: Conformal PM2.5 Mapping Under Spatial Covariate Shift: Satellite-Reanalysis Fusion for Africa's Green Industrial Transition
entries.version_inspected: 5 April 2026 preprint; publication status not asserted.
entries.task: Satellite/reanalysis PM2.5 mapping with LightGBM and split conformal intervals.
entries.validation_splits: Five location-grouped folds; 80/20 proper train/calibration; random inner tuning described.
entries.inputs_availability: ERA5, MERRA-2 and satellite inputs; location-year standardization described; not issue-time forecasting.
entries.uncertainty_advisory: Regional coverage degradation and reliability flags; no demonstrated clinical intervention benefit.
entries.overlap_limits: Relevant spatial-calibration diagnostics. Inner splits/group normalization need independent audit; stated spatial leakage resistance does not establish temporal availability.
entries.matrix_note: Spatial conformal mapping preprint; reanalysis and inner-validation audit limits.
